notes.text: I snap the receipt on my phone but then the app loses the photo half the time.
Approvals sit with my manager for a week, and nobody tells me.
I gave up on the mobile app and just email myself the receipts.
My manager approves things in batches on Fridays, so I wait.
Honestly the photo upload fails more than it works.
I do not know who has my report right now. It just says pending.
The export to our accounting system is the only part I trust.
Receipt capture worked fine for me, no complaints there.
I waited ten days for a four hundred dollar reimbursement.
Finance asked me to re-upload the same receipt twice.
Setup took me five minutes, the onboarding checklist was clear.
I check the status page every morning because I do not believe the pending label.
Setup was fine but I never found where to add my card.
I like that exports come out in the format my accountant wants.
The export button is hidden under three menus.
Participant hesitated, then switched to desktop.
Pending for days feels like nobody is looking at it.
